g.text: Longitudinal profile of a river (vertical scale exaggerated)
The river falls from 900 m at the source to 100 m at 50 km.
It is steeper upstream and gentler downstream: 400 m in the first
10 km (1:25) but only 100 m in the last 20 km (1:200).
Local exception: an abrupt step of about 40 m at about 20 km, so
the fall is not smooth everywhere.
A profile gives height and distance only: it does not show how fast
